entries.label: HELLO_1
entries.body:
Hello visitor!
We are the Slylandro. I am Content To Hover
a Slylandro Speaker.
Your presence here fills us with excitement!
We have gotten so few visitors over these many Drahn.
We hope you can stay to talk with us for a time.

a Slylandro Speaker.

We have gotten so few visitors over these many Drahn.
We hope you can stay to talk with us for a time.
entries.translation:
你好，訪客！
我們是斯萊蘭卓。 我是安然飄浮
一名斯萊蘭卓發言者。
你出現在這裡， 令我們興奮不已！
這麼多德拉恩以來， 訪客實在少得可憐。
希望你能留下來， 和我們聊一會兒。

entries.label: HELLO_2
entries.body:
You return with great speed.
In the last five Drahn, we have had only one visitor.
and now you have come twice in but a single Drahnasa.
How wonderful!
entries.source:

entries.translation:
你回來得真快。
過去五個德拉恩裡， 我們只有一位訪客。
現在你卻在短短一個德拉恩 薩內來了兩次。
真是太棒了！

entries.label: HELLO_3
entries.body:
Welcome back human Traveller!
We hope your journeys have brought you new insights
that you will share with us.
entries.source:
Welcome back human Traveller!
We hope your journeys have brought you new insights
that you will share with us.
entries.translation:
歡迎回來，人類旅行者！
希望旅程為你帶來了新的見 解
而你願意和我們分享。

entries.label: HELLO_4
entries.body:
Welcome back human Traveller!
We hope your journeys have brought you new insights
that you will share with us.
entries.source:
Welcome back human Traveller!
We hope your journeys have brought you new insights
that you will share with us.
entries.translation:
歡迎回來，人類旅行者！
希望旅程為你帶來了新的見 解

entries.label: RECALL_PROGRAM_1
entries.body:
Ah! human Traveller. We have news.
One of our probes finally returned home
and we have been able to reconfigure it
so that it will seek other probes and broadcast the destruct code sequence.
We expect the population of probes will decline swiftly.
Thank you so much for showing us our error.
We feel very badly about the inconvenience it has caused others.

entries.translation:
啊！人類旅行者。 我們有消息了。
其中一具探測器終於返回家 園
我們已經重新設定好
讓它搜尋其他探測器， 並廣播摧毀代碼序列。
預計探測器數量會迅速下 降。
非常感謝你指出我們的錯 誤。
對於它替其他人造成的不 便，我們深感抱歉。

entries.label: we_are_us0
entries.body: I am
entries.source: I am
entries.translation: 我是

entries.label: we_are_us1
entries.body: , Captain of the Earth starship
entries.source: , Captain of the Earth starship
entries.translation: ，地球星艦

entries.label: we_are_us2
entries.body: . What the heck are you?
entries.source: . What the heck are you?
entries.translation: 的船長。你們到底是什麼東 西？

entries.label: TERRIBLY_EXCITING
entries.body:
Oh, this is terribly exciting!
We will be happy to tell you about ourselves
if you will please, please do the same.
You see, we Slylandro have been extremely interested in learning about the galaxy
but our physique makes us incapable of leaving our gas giant home.
Therefore, we are totally reliant on our infrequent visitors
to keep us informed about events outside this planetary system.
And visitors usually only show up every few Drahn.
We hope that our newly deployed exploration probe fleet
will not only gather information for us
but inform other races of our presence here as well!

entries.translation:
喔，這實在太令人興奮了！
我們很樂意介紹自己
只要你拜託、拜託也同樣介 紹你們。
你瞧，我們斯萊蘭卓對了解 銀河一直極感興趣
但身體構造使我們無法離開 氣態巨行星家園。
因此，我們完全仰賴偶爾到 訪的訪客
提供這個行星系以外發生的 消息。
而訪客通常每隔好幾個德拉 恩才會出現。
希望剛部署的探索探測器艦 隊
不僅能替我們蒐集情報
也能把我們在這裡的消息告 訴其他種族！

entries.label: happy_to_tell_more
entries.body: Exactly how long is a `Drahn'?
entries.source: Exactly how long is a `Drahn'?
entries.translation: 一個`德拉恩'到底有多 長？

entries.label: TELL_MORE
entries.body:
The Drahn is our primary unit of time.
It lasts for an interval equivalent to
four million rotations of our planet.
A Drahn is subdivided into two-thousand Drahnasa.
Now please... our turn! Will you tell us about yourselves?!

entries.translation:
德拉恩是我們的主要時間單 位。
一個德拉恩的時間相當於
本行星旋轉四百萬次。
每個德拉恩又分成兩千個德 拉恩薩。
現在拜託……輪到我們了！ 你願意介紹自己嗎？！

entries.label: would_you_like_to_know_more
entries.body: We would be happy to tell you more about our people.
entries.source: We would be happy to tell you more about our people.
entries.translation: 我們很樂意多談一些自己族 人的事。

entries.label: YES_TELL_MORE
entries.body:
Yes! Yes! Please do!
Who ARE you?! Where are you from? Why have you come here?
Do you know of any other intelligent races?
Please! Tell us everything, EVERYTHING!
entries.source:
Yes! Yes! Please do!
Who ARE you?! Where are you from? Why have you come here?
Do you know of any other intelligent races?
Please! Tell us everything, EVERYTHING!
entries.translation:
好！好！快說吧！
你們究竟是誰？！ 來自哪裡？為什麼到這裡？
認識任何其他智慧種族嗎？
拜託！全部告訴我們， 一切的一切！

entries.label: we_come_from_earth
entries.body: Most of us come from a large, rocky world called Earth.
entries.source: Most of us come from a large, rocky world called Earth.
entries.translation: 我們大多來自一顆名為地球 的巨大岩石世界。

entries.label: OK_EARTH
entries.body:
Yes! That seems to be the pattern.
Just about everyone who comes by here
says they developed on a world a lot like that.
As far as we know, we're the only sentient species
who's ever evolved in the atmosphere of a gas giant.
Of course, from what we know, most Travellers like yourselves
don't have much interest in gas giants
so maybe there are others like us Slylandro out there somewhere.

entries.translation:
沒錯！看來模式就是如此。
幾乎每個經過這裡的人
都說他們是在類似世界上發 展的。
就我們所知，自己是唯一
在氣態巨行星大氣中演化的 智慧物種。
當然，根據目前所知， 多數像你一樣的旅行者
對氣態巨行星沒多大興趣
所以外面某處也許還有其他 斯萊蘭卓同類。

entries.label: we_explore
entries.body: We travel the galaxy in starships, seeking knowledge and contact with other sentients.
entries.source: We travel the galaxy in starships, seeking knowledge and contact with other sentients.
entries.translation: 我們搭乘星艦穿越銀河， 尋求知識並接觸其他智慧生 命。

entries.label: OK_EXPLORE
entries.body:
That must be great! To leave your planet, and roam the stars!
You don't know how monotonous living on a gas giant for three or four Drahn can be.
Clouds, clouds, clouds. Wind. Lightning. Clouds, clouds, clouds. That's it!
We know A LOT about clouds. If you've got any cloud questions, ask us.
We have over eight hundred different symbolic references just to describe them!
Most of the time, when we aren't eating
we hover around and talk about what the clouds look like.
Of course, the only things we know about are clouds, food and other Slylandro
so generally, that's what we think the clouds look like.

entries.translation:
那一定很棒！離開自己的行 星，漫遊群星！
你不知道在氣態巨行星上住 三、四個德拉恩有多麼單 調。
雲、雲、雲。風。閃電。 雲、雲、雲。就這些！
我們非常了解雲。 你有任何雲的問題， 儘管問。
光是描述雲，我們就有超過 八百種不同的象徵指稱！
大多數時候，只要沒有進食
我們便飄在四周， 討論雲看起來像什麼。
當然，我們只知道雲、 食物與其他斯萊蘭卓
所以一般來說， 想到的也就是這些東西。

entries.label: we_fight_urquan
entries.body: Our primary objective right now is to free ourselves from the Evil Ur-Quan.
entries.source: Our primary objective right now is to free ourselves from the Evil Ur-Quan.
entries.translation: 我們目前的首要目標， 是擺脫邪惡烏爾關。

entries.label: URQUAN_NICE_GUYS
entries.body:
The Ur-Quan?! The long brownish guys from the Milieu with all the eyes and arms?
They used to come visit us regularly about three Drahns ago.
They told us about all the interesting things they found from their scouting missions.
They were really nice! Why do you fight with them?

They were really nice! Why do you fight with them?
entries.translation:
烏爾關？！智慧共同體裡那 些褐色、長長的傢伙， 還有好多眼睛和手臂？
大約三個德拉恩前， 他們經常造訪我們。
他們會講述偵察任務中發現 的種種趣事。
他們人很好啊！ 你為什麼要和他們交戰？

entries.label: not_same_urquan
entries.body: I think you are confused. Those aren't the Ur-Quan we're talking about. Ours are green.
entries.source: I think you are confused. Those aren't the Ur-Quan we're talking about. Ours are green.
entries.translation: 我想你弄錯了。 那些不是我們說的烏爾關。 我們遇到的是綠色的。

entries.label: PERSONALITY_CHANGE
entries.body:
But the Ur-Quan were such good guys!
They had lots of interesting things to tell us about
and they never got impatient with our questions.
Hmmm. Well, I guess a lot can happen to a species in three Drahn
like turning green and evil.
entries.source:

Hmmm. Well, I guess a lot can happen to a species in three Drahn
like turning green and evil.
entries.translation:
但烏爾關以前人那麼好！
他們有好多趣事能說
而且從不對我們的問題感到 不耐煩。
嗯。好吧，我想三個德拉恩 足以讓一個物種發生很多變 化
例如變成綠色， 又變得邪惡。

entries.label: we_gather
entries.body: We are particularly interested in studying unusual planets and life forms.
entries.source: We are particularly interested in studying unusual planets and life forms.
entries.translation: 我們對研究異常行星與生命 形態特別感興趣。

entries.label: MAYBE_INTERESTED
entries.body:
Oh! Then you should go check out a planet orbiting a blue star not too far from here.
I think there is another blue star right next to it.
We can't desribe exactly where it is, but the people who told us about it
the Ur-Quan, I think, said that it was one of the rarest worlds in space
and that as far as they knew
there were only ten of the planets in this part of the galaxy.

entries.translation:
喔！那你應該去看看附近一 顆藍色恆星旁的行星。
我想旁邊正好還有另一顆藍 色恆星。
無法準確形容位置， 但告訴我們這件事的人
我想是烏爾關， 說它是宇宙中最罕見的世界 之一
而且就他們所知
這片銀河區域只有十顆那種 行星。

entries.label: enough_about_me
entries.body: That's enough about us, for now.
entries.source: That's enough about us, for now.
entries.translation: 我們的事暫時就說到這裡。

entries.label: OK_ENOUGH_YOU
entries.body: Okay, but please, can we talk about you some more later?
entries.source: Okay, but please, can we talk about you some more later?
entries.translation: 好吧，但拜託， 我們以後能再多談一些你的 事嗎？

entries.label: what_other_visitors
entries.body: Probes? What probes are you talking about?
entries.source: Probes? What probes are you talking about?
entries.translation: 探測器？你說的是什麼探測 器？

entries.label: VISITORS
entries.body:
You know, it's funny. We hadn't heard from the outside galaxy in a whole Drahnasa
and then the Melnorme come by and sell us a probe
and just a few hundred rotations later, YOU show up!
Oh! The probes? Right.
Well like we said, just a short time ago, a race called the Melnorme stopped by.
They said they had acquired some information revealing our existence
and they wanted to study us, if we didn't mind.
In fact, the Melnorme said they would PAY us for the right to do so.
I guess they are biology nuts, or something
anyway, in exchange for our information, they gave us a probe vessel.

entries.translation:
你知道嗎，真有趣。 我們整整一個德拉恩薩沒聽 到外界銀河的消息
接著梅爾諾姆前來， 賣給我們一具探測器
才又過幾百次自轉， 你就出現了！
喔！探測器？對喔。
就像我們說的， 不久前有個名為梅爾諾姆的 種族來訪。
他們說取得了一些揭露我們 存在的情報
而且只要我們不介意， 就想研究我們。
事實上，梅爾諾姆說願意為 研究權付費。
我猜他們是生物學狂熱分子 之類的吧
總之，為了交換我們的情 報，他們給了一艘探測船。

entries.label: any_other_visitors
entries.body: Tell me about the other races who have visited you over the years.
entries.source: Tell me about the other races who have visited you over the years.
entries.translation: 談談多年來造訪過你們的其 他種族。

entries.label: LONG_AGO
entries.body:
Years? Oh.. you mean Drahn.
Well, let's see... there was the Melnorme just a few rotations back
then we go all the way back over three Drahn ago to the Ur-Quan
and the other Milieu guys... the Yuli and the Drall, I think.

then we go all the way back over three Drahn ago to the Ur-Quan
and the other Milieu guys... the Yuli and the Drall, I think.
entries.translation:
年？喔……你是指德拉恩。
嗯，讓我想想…… 幾次自轉前有梅爾諾姆
接著得一路回溯到三個多德 拉恩前的烏爾關
還有其他智慧共同體成 員……我想是尤利與德拉 爾。

entries.label: what_about_sentient_milieu
entries.body: Milieu? What is the Milieu and who are the Yuli and the Drall?
entries.source: Milieu? What is the Milieu and who are the Yuli and the Drall?
entries.translation: 共同體？智慧共同體是什 麼，尤利與德拉爾又是誰？

entries.label: MET_TAALO_THEY_ARE_FROM
entries.body:
Hmmm... let me remember... that was a long, long time ago... I was only a nymph then
ah, yes... that's it!
The Sentient Milieu was a cooperative association of sentient alien species
The Yuli, the Drall, the Taalo, the Mael-Num, the Faz and the Ur-Quan
who lived across a wide section of the galaxy.
They talked with us fairly frequently for almost half a Drahn
then suddenly the visits stopped and we haven't heard from them since.

entries.translation:
嗯……讓我回想…… 那是很久、很久以前…… 當時我還只是隻若蟲
啊，對……想起來了！
智慧共同體是由智慧外星物 種組成的合作協會
包括尤利、德拉爾、塔洛、 梅爾－努姆、法茲與烏爾關
居住範圍橫跨銀河一大片區 域。
將近半個德拉恩裡， 他們相當頻繁地與我們交談
後來造訪突然中止， 從此再也沒聽到他們的消 息。

entries.label: who_else
entries.body: Were there any other visitors here besides the Melnorme and Milieu races?
entries.source: Were there any other visitors here besides the Melnorme and Milieu races?
entries.translation: 除了梅爾諾姆與智慧共同體 種族，還有其他訪客來過 嗎？

entries.label: PRECURSORS
entries.body:
Yes, there was another race... a highly sophisticated species of shaggy giants
who made repeated trips to our world over a period of several Drahn.
They even installed a broadcasting satellite in orbit around our world
which let us talk with them whenever we wanted. They were called the
the
I'm sorry, I can't remember their names. It was a long long time ago.

entries.translation:
有，還有另一個種族…… 由毛茸巨人組成的高度先進 物種
他們在好幾個德拉恩期間， 反覆造訪我們的世界。
甚至在環繞我們世界的軌道 上裝了廣播衛星
讓我們隨時都能與他們交 談。他們叫做
叫做
抱歉，我記不得名字。 那是非常、非常久以前的事 了。

entries.label: precursors_yow
entries.body: Yow! That sounds like the Precursors! What else can you tell us about this race?
entries.source: Yow! That sounds like the Precursors! What else can you tell us about this race?
entries.translation: 哇！聽起來像先驅者！ 還能告訴我們多少這個種族 的事？

entries.label: ABOUT_PRECURSORS
entries.body:
I wish I knew more of the information you seek, Traveller
but we last saw the Shaggy Ones just over 39 Drahn ago
and very little from that era has remained intact in our history chants.
Hold on a minute, let me consult with associates Joyous Lifting and Sullen Plummet.
Joyous Lifting, who has a better memory than I
recalls that the Shaggy Ones were described as being... worried.
They were always hurrying from place to place, seeking knowledge
as though they were in a desperate search for some important secret
some answer to a question that they never shared with us.
Sullen Plummet remembers that the last time the Shaggy Ones visited our world
they came aboard a great circular starship, one even larger than your own.
They had discovered their Answer and were leaving to go somewhere
and they didn't tell us exactly where `somewhere' was.

旅行者，我真希望自己多知 道一些你尋找的情報
但我們上次見到毛茸先祖， 已是三十九個多德拉恩前
那個時代幾乎沒多少內容， 完整留存在歷史吟唱裡。
等一下，讓我詢問同伴歡欣 上升與鬱鬱下墜。
記憶力比我好的歡欣上升
想起毛茸先祖曾被形容 為……憂心忡忡。
他們總是匆匆從一處趕往另 一處，尋求知識
彷彿正不顧一切地尋找某個 重大祕密
尋找某個他們從未透露給我 們的問題答案。
鬱鬱下墜記得， 毛茸先祖最後一次造訪我們 的世界時
搭乘一艘巨大圓形星艦， 甚至比你的船還大。
他們已經找到自己的答案， 準備離開前往某個地方
但沒有明確告訴我們`某個 地方'究竟是哪裡。

entries.label: must_know_more
entries.body: This is EXTREMELY important to us! Don't you know any more?
entries.source: This is EXTREMELY important to us! Don't you know any more?
entries.translation: 這對我們極其重要！ 你真的不知道更多了嗎？

entries.label: ALL_WE_KNOW
entries.body:
No, I have told you... one moment, Joyous Lifting transmits.
  
Joyous Lifting has remembered something else
though it does not relate to the Shaggy Ones' Question, Answer, or Departure Destination.
What my associate communicates is the description of a set of ten worlds, unlike all others.
The Shaggy Ones either discovered these planets or... this is garbled.. assembled them?
We were told the planets were... again this is confusing... organized (?) in some pattern
which in some way alluded to the Shaggy Ones' ultimate fate.
One of the worlds was described as orbiting one of a pair of blue stars not far from here.
Another of these worlds circled a large white sun.
That is all we can remember.

entries.translation:
不，我已經告訴你…… 稍等，歡欣上升傳來訊息。
  
歡欣上升又想起一件事
儘管與毛茸先祖的問題、 答案或出發目的地無關。
我同伴傳來的是一組十個世 界的描述，全都與眾不同。
毛茸先祖不是發現了這些行 星，就是……這段模糊不 清……組裝了它們？
有人告訴我們，這些行 星……這裡又很令人困 惑……以某種規律排列 （？）
而這項規律以某種方式暗示 毛茸先祖最終的命運。
其中一個世界環繞附近一對 藍色恆星的其中一顆。
另一個世界則環繞一顆巨大 白色太陽。
我們只記得這些。

entries.label: who_are_you
entries.body: Pardon me, but who exactly are you again?
entries.source: Pardon me, but who exactly are you again?
entries.translation: 不好意思，你們到底是誰來 著？

entries.label: WE_ARE_SLY
entries.body: We are the Slylandro, a race of kind, curious gas bag people.
entries.source: We are the Slylandro, a race of kind, curious gas bag people.
entries.translation: 我們是斯萊蘭卓， 由善良好奇的氣囊族人組 成。

entries.label: like_more_about_you
entries.body: Hmmm. Sounds interesting! Tell us more.
entries.source: Hmmm. Sounds interesting! Tell us more.
entries.translation: 嗯。聽起來很有意思！ 再多說一些。

entries.label: SURE_KNOW_WHAT
entries.body:
Certainly, provided you share with us similar information.
What would you like to know?
entries.source:
Certainly, provided you share with us similar information.
What would you like to know?
entries.translation:
當然可以，前提是你也分享 類似情報。
你想知道什麼？

entries.label: what_about_home
entries.body: Tell us about your home... this gas giant planet.
entries.source: Tell us about your home... this gas giant planet.
entries.translation: 談談你們的家園…… 這顆氣態巨行星。

entries.label: ABOUT_HOME
entries.body:
Our planet, which we call Source, has no solid surface as yours likely does.
Our `world' is the five hundred kilometer band of atmosphere in which we can survive.
Below this are the Depths... a dark, hostile region
which grows increasingly darker, and more hostile, the farther one goes.
A typical feat of courage for Slylandro juveniles is to sink far enough into the Depths
so that the juvenile's gas bag is almost ruptured by the pressure.
The tissue scars left by the trip last many rotations
and are thought to attract comely mates.
Above our world is Void. When we travel up too far into Void
we grow giddy and behave inappropriately.

entries.translation:
我們稱自己的行星為源星， 它大概不像你的行星一樣擁 有固態表面。
我們的`世界'是可以生存 的五百公里厚大氣帶。
下方則是深淵…… 一片黑暗而充滿敵意的區域
越往下走，就會變得越來越 黑暗、越來越危險。
斯萊蘭卓青少年典型的勇氣 考驗，是沉入足夠深的深淵
直到壓力幾乎讓自己的氣囊 破裂。
旅程留下的組織傷疤會持續 許多次自轉
據說能吸引漂亮的伴侶。
我們世界上方則是虛空。 太過深入虛空時
我們會頭昏目眩， 做出不得體的舉動。

entries.label: what_about_culture
entries.body: What can you tell us about your culture?
entries.source: What can you tell us about your culture?
entries.translation: 能告訴我們多少你們文化的 事？

entries.label: ABOUT_CULTURE
entries.body:
We have an egalitarian society here. All are equal.
Of course, that doesn't stop some people from being stupid fools or jerks.
But on a world as huge as Source, where there are no barriers to restrict your travel
if someone is bothering you, you simply go somewhere else.
As you might have guessed, we have no physical technology.
In our long history, several of our people have tried to work with objects
constructing weapons and other tools from the carcasses of dead beasts
but eventually, whatever it was they were building got too heavy
and dragged them down to the Depths.

entries.translation:
這裡是個平等社會。 所有人一律平等。
當然，這阻止不了某些人成 為愚蠢白痴或混蛋。
但源星如此巨大， 也沒有任何障礙限制移動
若有人打擾你， 只要去別的地方即可。
你大概也猜到了， 我們沒有實體科技。
漫長歷史中，有幾位族人曾 試著操作物體
用死去野獸的屍骸打造武器 與其他工具
但最後，無論他們在造什 麼，都會變得太重
把他們拖入深淵。

entries.label: what_about_history
entries.body: What about your history?
entries.source: What about your history?
entries.translation: 那你們的歷史呢？

entries.label: ABOUT_HISTORY
entries.body:
Since we possess no technology, we have no permanent way to record the passing of events.
Instead we use the History Chants... long songs whose rhythms and patterns
help prevent the introduction of error into the record.
When the Shaggy Ones first arrived over 41 Drahns ago
we had no words for aliens or ships, for stars or planets.
Our skies are an opaque swirl of colors. We knew nothing of the universe outside Source.
The Shaggy Ones taught us most of the New Words
and after they departed we remembered them for the many long Drahn
until ships from the Sentient Milieu arrived.

entries.translation:
由於沒有科技， 我們無法永久記錄事件的流 逝。
所以採用歷史吟唱…… 悠長歌曲的節奏與模式
有助於防止錯誤混入記載。
毛茸先祖在四十一個多德拉 恩前初次抵達時
我們沒有外星人或船隻、 恆星或行星的詞彙。
天空是一片不透明的色彩漩 渦。我們對源星以外的宇宙 一無所知。
毛茸先祖教導我們大部分新 詞彙
而他們離去後， 經過許多漫長德拉恩， 我們依然記得
直到智慧共同體的船隻抵 達。

entries.label: what_about_biology
entries.body: Tell us about your biology.
entries.source: Tell us about your biology.
entries.translation: 談談你們的生物構造。

entries.label: ABOUT_BIOLOGY
entries.body:
Our world, which we call Source, has been home to our species for many thousands of Drahn.
We evolved from simpler, unimodular beings who thrive in atmospheric convection cells.
At first, we were little more than mindless consumers
who glided at the edge of windwalls straining the air for small animalcules.
But even then we were social creatures, who invented language
so that we could better cooperate when herding food into dense concentrations.
There are many hundreds of species here in Source
producers, consumers, hunters and parasites, but so far
we are the only species here to achieve intelligence.

entries.translation:
我們稱為源星的世界， 數千個德拉恩來一直是我族 家園。
我們從更簡單、 只有單一模組的生物演化而 來；它們繁衍於大氣對流 胞。
起初，我們不過是沒有心智 的消費者
滑翔於風牆邊緣， 從空氣中濾出微小生物。
但即使當時，我們已是群居 生物，還發明了語言
讓彼此把食物趕成密集群落 時，能更妥善合作。
源星這裡有數百個物種
包括生產者、消費者、 獵食者與寄生物， 但目前為止
我們是這裡唯一獲得智慧的 物種。

entries.label: enough_info
entries.body: Thank you. That's sufficient for now.
entries.source: Thank you. That's sufficient for now.
entries.translation: 謝謝。目前知道這些就夠 了。

entries.label: OK_ENOUGH_INFO
entries.body: My pleasure. Now let's talk about you and your peoples.
entries.source: My pleasure. Now let's talk about you and your peoples.
entries.translation: 不客氣。現在來談談你和你 的族人。

entries.label: where_are_you
entries.body: What are those glowy bits inside of you?
entries.source: What are those glowy bits inside of you?
entries.translation: 你體內那些發光部位是什 麼？

entries.label: DOWN_HERE
entries.body:
OH MY! I forgot! You creatures see in the visual range and can see our...
well our, er... well, WE can't see them
Ehhh... Ahem... What I mean to say is... they are...
well we use them for when the male and the female... ahem
Look, I'd rather if you didn't ask about them, okay?
(especially not if front of Sullen Plummet... she's shy.)

entries.translation:
天啊！我忘了！ 你們這些生物能看見可見 光，也看得見我們的……
就是我們的，呃……這個， 我們自己看不見
呃……咳咳…… 我的意思是……它們是……
嗯，雄性和雌性要…… 咳咳時，我們會用到它們
聽著，我希望你別再問了， 好嗎？
（尤其別在鬱鬱下墜面前 問……她很害羞。）

entries.label: thats_impossible_1
entries.body: I said... WHAT ARE THOSE GLOWY THINGS INSIDE OF YOU?!
entries.source: I said... WHAT ARE THOSE GLOWY THINGS INSIDE OF YOU?!
entries.translation: 我說……你體內那些發光東 西到底是什麼？！

entries.label: NO_ITS_NOT_1
entries.body:
Great. Now you've done it! Just look at Sullen Plummet.
You've embarrassed her so badly that she can't even regulate her ballast.
entries.source:
Great. Now you've done it! Just look at Sullen Plummet.
You've embarrassed her so badly that she can't even regulate her ballast.
entries.translation:
太好了。現在你闖禍了！ 看看鬱鬱下墜。
她羞得連浮力都調節不了。

entries.label: thats_impossible_2
entries.body: Look, I'm sorry I asked about your... glowy bits.
entries.source: Look, I'm sorry I asked about your... glowy bits.
entries.translation: 聽著，很抱歉問了你那 些……發光部位。

entries.label: NO_ITS_NOT_2
entries.body:
That's okay. Actually, your explicit questions
have put Sullen Plummet in an unusual and intriguing mood.
I will explore this change more fully when this conversation is over.
entries.source:
That's okay. Actually, your explicit questions
have put Sullen Plummet in an unusual and intriguing mood.
I will explore this change more fully when this conversation is over.
entries.translation:
沒關係。其實你露骨的問題
讓鬱鬱下墜陷入一種不尋常 而耐人尋味的情緒。
等這場對話結束， 我會更深入探索這項變化。

entries.label: bye
entries.body: Goodbye Slylandro gas bags.
entries.source: Goodbye Slylandro gas bags.
entries.translation: 再見，斯萊蘭卓氣囊族。

entries.label: GOODBYE_1
entries.body: Goodbye human fluid sack!
entries.source: Goodbye human fluid sack!
entries.translation: 再見，人類液體袋！

entries.label: GOODBYE_2
entries.body: Goodbye human fluid sack!
entries.source: Goodbye human fluid sack!
entries.translation: 再見，人類液體袋！

entries.label: what_are_probes
entries.body: Can you give me details about your probes?
entries.source: Can you give me details about your probes?
entries.translation: 能詳細介紹你們的探測器 嗎？

entries.label: PROBES_ARE
entries.body:
Sure, if you are interested. In exchange for information about the life on Source
the Melnorme offered to give us a remote exploration probe.
It would roam the galaxy gathering information and contacting alien races
and when it had filled its data storage units, it would return here
and reveal to us everything it had learned!
entries.source:
Sure, if you are interested. In exchange for information about the life on Source
the Melnorme offered to give us a remote exploration probe.
It would roam the galaxy gathering information and contacting alien races
and when it had filled its data storage units, it would return here
and reveal to us everything it had learned!
entries.translation:
當然，如果你有興趣。 為了交換源星生命的情報
梅爾諾姆提議送給我們一具 遠程探索探測器。
它會漫遊銀河蒐集情報， 接觸外星種族
等資料儲存單元裝滿後， 便返回此處
向我們揭露學到的一切！

entries.label: know_more_probe
entries.body: Is that it? The probe can't do anything else?
entries.source: Is that it? The probe can't do anything else?
entries.translation: 就這樣？探測器不能做其他 事嗎？

entries.label: OK_WHAT_MORE_PROBE
entries.body:
Oh yeah! How could I forget... this is the REALLY neat part!
The probe was self-replicating!
When it wasn't recording data, it would pulverize rocks and stuff
then suck in the debris. When it had enough raw materials
it would fabricate a duplicate of itself which could self-replicate too!
We expect the first probe to return in a few hundred rotations
and then we should see an increasing number thereafter.

entries.translation:
喔，對！我怎麼忘了…… 接下來才是真的厲害！
探測器能自我複製！
沒有記錄資料時， 它會把岩石之類的東西粉碎
接著吸入碎屑。 累積足夠原料後
就會造出一具同樣能自我複 製的分身！
預計第一具探測器會在幾百 次自轉後返回
此後見到的數量應該會越來 越多。

entries.label: where_probes_from
entries.body: Where exactly did you say you got your probe from?
entries.source: Where exactly did you say you got your probe from?
entries.translation: 你剛才說探測器究竟是從哪 裡來的？

entries.label: PROBES_FROM_MELNORME
entries.body:
From the Melnorme Traveller-Traders.
It was catalog item 2418... Remote Self-Replicating Robot Explorer Probe
the economy model.
entries.source:
From the Melnorme Traveller-Traders.
It was catalog item 2418... Remote Self-Replicating Robot Explorer Probe
the economy model.
entries.translation:
來自梅爾諾姆的商旅艦。
那是第 2418 號目錄商品…… 遠程自我複製機器探索探測 器
經濟型。

entries.label: why_sell
entries.body: Why did the Melnorme sell it to you?
entries.source: Why did the Melnorme sell it to you?
entries.translation: 梅爾諾姆為什麼把它賣給你 們？

entries.label: SELL_FOR_INFO
entries.body:
The Melnorme traded it to us for data on the life on Source.
They said the information was unique, and was worth
oh, I don't really understand their units of exchange
something like 10,000 Gree-dots... or something like that.
Fortunately, that was EXACTLY the price of their catalog item 2418
Remote Self-Replicating Robot Explorer Probe.

The Melnorme traded it to us for data on the life on Source.

oh, I don't really understand their units of exchange

Fortunately, that was EXACTLY the price of their catalog item 2418

entries.translation:
梅爾諾姆用它交換源星生命 的資料。
他們說這些情報獨一無二， 價值大約
喔，我實在不懂他們的交換 單位
好像是一萬個格里點…… 還是類似的東西。
幸運的是，這正好就是第 2418 號目錄商品的價格
遠程自我複製機器探索探測 器。

entries.label: how_long_ago
entries.body: How long ago did you get the probe?
entries.source: How long ago did you get the probe?
entries.translation: 你們是多久前拿到探測器 的？

entries.label: FIFTY_THOUSAND_ROTATIONS
entries.body: Two or three hundred rotations, I guess.
entries.source: Two or three hundred rotations, I guess.
entries.translation: 我猜是兩、三百次自轉以 前。

entries.label: whats_probes_mission
entries.body: What was the probe's program?
entries.source: What was the probe's program?
entries.translation: 探測器的程式是什麼？

entries.label: SEEK_OUT_NEW_LIFE
entries.body:
It was sent on a 500 rotation mission!...
...to seek out new life and new civilizations...to boldly go where no
catalog item 2418... Remote Self-Replicating Robot Explorer Probe
had gone before!
entries.source:
It was sent on a 500 rotation mission!...
...to seek out new life and new civilizations...to boldly go where no
catalog item 2418... Remote Self-Replicating Robot Explorer Probe
had gone before!
entries.translation:
它奉命執行五百次自轉的任 務！……
……尋找新的生命與新的文 明……勇敢航向從未有任何
第 2418 號目錄商品…… 遠程自我複製機器探索探測 器
到過的地方！

entries.label: if_only_one
entries.body: Can you explain the probe's replication ability?
entries.source: Can you explain the probe's replication ability?
entries.translation: 能解釋探測器的複製能力 嗎？

entries.label: THEY_REPLICATE
entries.body:
Well, we're not hardware people, so we only know the theory.
What happens is that while the probe is exploring space
whenever it's not doing something more important
it hunts for asteroids and similar space junk
zaps it into its component parts, absorbs the debris
and when it has enough raw materials stored inside
it manufactures a perfect replica of itself.
So even though we only bought one probe
by now there should be hundreds of probes, maybe even thousands!

嗯，我們不懂硬體， 所以只知道理論。
探測器探索太空時
只要沒有更重要的事情要做
就會尋找小行星與類似太空 垃圾
將其分解成組成部分、 吸收碎屑
而內部儲存足夠原料後
便製造出與自己完全相同的 複製品。
所以儘管只買了一具探測器
現在應該已有幾百具， 甚至可能幾千具了！

entries.label: enough_probe
entries.body: I've heard enough, thanks.
entries.source: I've heard enough, thanks.
entries.translation: 我聽夠了，謝謝。

entries.label: OK_ENOUGH_PROBE
entries.body: Okay, what else can we talk about?
entries.source: Okay, what else can we talk about?
entries.translation: 好，還能談些什麼？

entries.label: why_probe_always_attack
entries.body: Well why then do your probes attack our ships?
entries.source: Well why then do your probes attack our ships?
entries.translation: 那你們的探測器為什麼攻擊 我們的船？

entries.label: ONLY_DEFEND
entries.body:
Our probes DO NOT attack!
They have only defensive capabilities.
Offensive behavior is NOT part of the instructions we programmed into the probe.
To do so would be reprehensible!
entries.source:
Our probes DO NOT attack!
They have only defensive capabilities.
Offensive behavior is NOT part of the instructions we programmed into the probe.
To do so would be reprehensible!
entries.translation:
我們的探測器不會攻擊！
它們只有防禦能力。
我們寫入探測器的指令不包 含任何進攻行為。
那樣做應受譴責！

entries.label: talk_more_probe_attack
entries.body: Can we talk a little bit more about the probe's program?
entries.source: Can we talk a little bit more about the probe's program?
entries.translation: 能再多談一點探測器的程式 嗎？

entries.label: NO_PROBLEM_BUT_SURE
entries.body: Sure. What would you like to know?
entries.source: Sure. What would you like to know?
entries.translation: 當然。你想知道什麼？

entries.label: tell_me_about_basics
entries.body: Would you explain the general outline of the probe's program?
entries.source: Would you explain the general outline of the probe's program?
entries.translation: 能說明探測器程式的大致架 構嗎？

entries.label: BASIC_COMMANDS
entries.body:
Sure. It was a difficult task for us, since we'd never done anything like that before
but for the most part we just adjusted its standard program which went something like:
    SCAN (for targets, as defined in Target List).
    IF (no current target).
    THEN (select New target from Current Targets list, using specified priorities).
    IF (Current Position is AT Current Target).
    THEN (Set Current Behavior to New Behavior, based on Behavior Priority Settings).
    PERFORM (Current Behavior).
Okay, that's the basic program... I said it was simple
and here are the tables used by the program:
    TARGET LIST (with associated Target Priority).
        Space Vessel (5).
        Transmission Source (4).
        Astronomical Anomaly (3).
        Planet Bearing Life Signature (2).
        Raw Replication Materials (1).
    PROBE BEHAVIORS (With assigned priorities).
        Communicate (5).
        Record Data (4).
        Analyze Data (3).
        Seek Replication Materials (999).
        Move to Current Target (1).
That's it.

entries.translation:
當然。這項任務很困難， 因為我們以前從沒做過類似 的事
但大致上只是調整它的標準 程式，內容大概是：
    掃描（依目標清單的定義尋 找目標）。
    如果（目前沒有目標）。
    那麼（按照指定優先順序， 從目前目標清單選擇新目 標）。
    如果（目前位置位於目前目 標）。
    那麼（依據行為優先設定， 將目前行為設為新行為）。
    執行（目前行為）。
好，這就是基本程式…… 我說過很簡單
以下則是程式使用的表格：
    目標清單（以及對應的目標 優先值）。
        太空船隻（5）。
        傳輸來源（4）。
        天文異象（3）。
        帶有生命跡象的行星（ 2）。
        原始複製材料（1）。
    探測器行為（以及指定的優 先值）。
        通訊（5）。
        記錄資料（4）。
        分析資料（3）。
        尋找複製材料（999）。
        移往目前目標（1）。
就是這樣。

entries.label: tell_basics_again
entries.body: What's the general outline of the probe's program again?
entries.source: What's the general outline of the probe's program again?
entries.translation: 再說一次探測器程式的大致 架構？

        Analyze Data (Unanalyzed data in queue) - (3).
        Prepare Replication Materials (Any Target) - (2).
        Move to Current Target (Any target) - (1).

entries.label: what_effect
entries.body: What is the effect of the Priority Settings on Behavior?
entries.source: What is the effect of the Priority Settings on Behavior?
entries.translation: 優先設定會對行為產生什麼 影響？

entries.label: AFFECTS_BEHAVIOR
entries.body:
I'm pretty sure the way it works is that every time a behavior is completed or interrupted
the program selects a new behavior based on the defined Behavior Target Priorities
and what kind of Target is currently selected... I think.
A really high priority would cause a probe to focus its attention on that behavior.
entries.source:
I'm pretty sure the way it works is that every time a behavior is completed or interrupted
the program selects a new behavior based on the defined Behavior Target Priorities
and what kind of Target is currently selected... I think.
A really high priority would cause a probe to focus its attention on that behavior.
entries.translation:
我很確定運作方式是， 每當一項行為完成或中斷
程式會依據已定義的行為目 標優先值
以及目前選取的目標種類， 挑選新行為……應該吧。
非常高的優先值會使探測器 專注於那項行為。

entries.label: how_does_probe_defend
entries.body: You mentioned the probe's defensive capabilities. Elaborate.
entries.source: You mentioned the probe's defensive capabilities. Elaborate.
entries.translation: 你提到探測器的防禦能力。 詳細說明。

entries.label: ONLY_SELF_DEFENSE
entries.body:
That behavior was hard-coded by the Melnorme.
We couldn't mess with it.
Essentially, the probe will only fire its weapons if it has been attacked
and cannot communicate with the attacker.
entries.source:
That behavior was hard-coded by the Melnorme.
We couldn't mess with it.
Essentially, the probe will only fire its weapons if it has been attacked
and cannot communicate with the attacker.
entries.translation:
那項行為由梅爾諾姆硬寫在 系統裡。
我們無法動它。
基本上，探測器只會在遭到 攻擊
而且無法與攻擊者溝通時， 才會開火。

entries.label: combat_behavior
entries.body: And when defending itself, it uses its lightning weapon?
entries.source: And when defending itself, it uses its lightning weapon?
entries.translation: 所以它會在自我防禦時使用 閃電武器？

entries.label: MISSILE_BATTERIES
entries.body:
No. The probe is armed with a battery of missiles.
It doesn't use its electrical discharge device in combat.
entries.source:
No. The probe is armed with a battery of missiles.
It doesn't use its electrical discharge device in combat.
entries.translation:
不會。探測器配備一組飛彈 發射器。
戰鬥時不使用放電裝置。

entries.label: what_missile_batteries
entries.body: What missile batteries? It always attacked us with lightning bolts!
entries.source: What missile batteries? It always attacked us with lightning bolts!
entries.translation: 什麼飛彈發射器？ 它每次都用閃電攻擊我們！

entries.label: LIGHTNING_ONLY_FOR_HARVESTING
entries.body:
That's impossible! Its inconceivable!
The electrical discharge device is used only for breaking down raw replication materials
into their component compounds for easy gathering.
entries.source:
That's impossible! Its inconceivable!
The electrical discharge device is used only for breaking down raw replication materials
into their component compounds for easy gathering.
entries.translation:
不可能！無法想像！
放電裝置只用於分解原始複 製材料
把材料化為組成化合物， 方便收集。

entries.label: tell_me_about_rep_1
entries.body: Would you tell me about the `Replication' behavior?
entries.source: Would you tell me about the `Replication' behavior?
entries.translation: 能談談`複製'行為嗎？

entries.label: ABOUT_REP
entries.body:
I'd be glad to! You see, the probe has the capability
to seek out raw materials, process the raw materials into component compounds
collect the compounds, and then when it has a sufficient supply
it can build a duplicate of itself.
We decided that since we had only one probe, we should change the Replication priority
and crank it up so that there would be more probes sooner.
entries.source:
I'd be glad to! You see, the probe has the capability
to seek out raw materials, process the raw materials into component compounds
collect the compounds, and then when it has a sufficient supply
it can build a duplicate of itself.
We decided that since we had only one probe, we should change the Replication priority
and crank it up so that there would be more probes sooner.
entries.translation:
非常樂意！你瞧， 探測器有能力
尋找原料、把原料處理成組 成化合物
收集化合物，等供應量足夠 後
便能造出自己的複製品。
我們想，既然只有一具探測 器，就應該更改複製優先值
把它調高，好讓更多探測器 更快出現。

entries.label: what_set_priority
entries.body: Uh... what priority did you assign to replication?
entries.source: Uh... what priority did you assign to replication?
entries.translation: 呃……你們把複製設成什麼 優先值？

entries.label: MAXIMUM
entries.body:
Well, the factory setting was two, in between Movement at one
and Analyze Data at three. I told Joyous Lifting to set it a bit higher
let me ask him what he set it to...
Oh! My! That was a bit extreme, wasn't it?
Joyous Lifting told me he changed it to nine hundred ninety-nine
the highest setting on the dial.

the highest setting on the dial.
entries.translation:
嗯，原廠設定是二， 介於優先值一的移動
與優先值三的分析資料之 間。我叫歡欣上升把它調高 一點
讓我問問他設成多少……
喔！天啊！這有點太極端 了，對吧？
歡欣上升說，他改成九百九 十九
也就是刻度盤上的最高設 定。

entries.label: enough_problem
entries.body: Let's talk more about this later on.
entries.source: Let's talk more about this later on.
entries.translation: 這件事以後再多談。

entries.label: OK_ENOUGH_PROBLEM
entries.body: Okay.
entries.source: Okay.
entries.translation: 好。

entries.label: probe_has_bug
entries.body: Your probe DOES destroy ships and I can prove it!
entries.source: Your probe DOES destroy ships and I can prove it!
entries.translation: 你們的探測器確實會摧毀船 隻，我可以證明！

entries.label: NO_IT_DOESNT
entries.body:
No! It cannot! It is not programmed for hostile behavior!
What is your reasoning?!
entries.source:
No! It cannot! It is not programmed for hostile behavior!
What is your reasoning?!
entries.translation:
不！不可能！它沒有攻擊行 為的程式！
你的推理是什麼？！

entries.label: tell_me_about_attack
entries.body: Think about what a probe does when it meets a ship.
entries.source: Think about what a probe does when it meets a ship.
entries.translation: 想想探測器遇見船隻時會做 什麼。

entries.label: ATTACK_NO_PROBLEM
entries.body:
Space ships are the probe's highest priority
because we want more than anything to make friendly contact with alien races.
entries.source:
Space ships are the probe's highest priority
because we want more than anything to make friendly contact with alien races.
entries.translation:
太空船隻是探測器的最高優 先目標
因為我們最希望與外星種族 建立友好接觸。

entries.label: tell_me_about_rep_2
entries.body: Think about a probe's Replication behavior.
entries.source: Think about a probe's Replication behavior.
entries.translation: 想想探測器的複製行為。

entries.label: REP_NO_PROBLEM
entries.body: The probe seeks raw materials, and processes them in preparation for Replication.
entries.source: The probe seeks raw materials, and processes them in preparation for Replication.
entries.translation: 探測器尋找原料， 再進行處理，為複製作準 備。

entries.label: what_about_rep_priorities
entries.body: Think about the effect of changing the replication behavior's priority.
entries.source: Think about the effect of changing the replication behavior's priority.
entries.translation: 想想改變複製行為的優先值 會有什麼影響。

entries.label: MAXIMUM_SO_WHAT
entries.body:
The answer is simple... it would spend more of its time seeking raw materials
for its replication process. So what?
entries.source:
The answer is simple... it would spend more of its time seeking raw materials
for its replication process. So what?
entries.translation:
答案很簡單…… 它會花更多時間尋找原料
供複製程序使用。 那又怎樣？

entries.label: think_about_rep_priorities
entries.body: Now, what will it do to a ship, given that its Replication priority is set to maximum?
entries.source: Now, what will it do to a ship, given that its Replication priority is set to maximum?
entries.translation: 那麼，既然複製優先值已設 為最高，它會對船隻做什 麼？

entries.label: UH_OH
entries.body:
I don't see what you are getting at, but I'll play along with you.
Like I said, alien ships are THE top priority target.
Once a probe scanned a ship, it would instantly move toward it.
Then, when it got to the ship, it would initiate communication automatically.
When communications were terminated, a new behavior would be selected, and...
Uh-oh.
A new behavior would be selected, and since the Replication setting was set to maximum
the probe wouldn't get time to pick a new target... it would use the current target
the ship
for raw Replication materials
it would process the ship
break it into component compounds
with electrical discharges.
Oh no!
what have we done?
Traveller! You must tell us what we can do!
How can we stop the probes from destroying all life in the galaxy?!

我不明白你想暗示什麼， 但就陪你推演下去。
就像我說的，外星船隻是最 優先的目標。
探測器掃描到船隻後， 會立刻朝它移動。
接著抵達船隻時， 自動發起通訊。
通訊終止後，系統便會選擇 新行為，然後……
糟糕。
系統會選擇新行為， 而複製設定已調到最高
探測器根本沒時間挑選新目 標……會直接使用目前的目 標
那艘船
當作原始複製材料
它會處理那艘船
用放電把它分解
成組成化合物。
喔，不！
我們做了什麼？
旅行者！你必須告訴我們該 怎麼辦！
要怎樣阻止探測器摧毀銀河 中的所有生命？！

entries.label: hunt_them_down
entries.body: Someone is going to have to hunt them all down and destroy them.
entries.source: Someone is going to have to hunt them all down and destroy them.
entries.translation: 得有人把它們全部獵殺並摧 毀。

entries.label: GROW_TOO_FAST
entries.body:
No, that would never work!
The probes will replicate too fast!
As soon as you destroyed one, two would take its place!
entries.source:
No, that would never work!
The probes will replicate too fast!
As soon as you destroyed one, two would take its place!
entries.translation:
不，那絕對行不通！
探測器複製得太快了！
每摧毀一具，就會有兩具取 而代之！

entries.label: sue_melnorme
entries.body: Well to begin with, if I were you, I'd sue the Melnorme.
entries.source: Well to begin with, if I were you, I'd sue the Melnorme.
entries.translation: 嗯，首先，如果我是你， 就會控告梅爾諾姆。

entries.label: SIGNED_WAIVER
entries.body:
Sorry. The Melnorme made us agree to a formal Waiver of Damages
in case something like this happened.
entries.source:
Sorry. The Melnorme made us agree to a formal Waiver of Damages
in case something like this happened.
entries.translation:
抱歉。梅爾諾姆要求我們簽 署正式損害免責書
以防這類事情發生。

entries.label: recall_signal
entries.body: Couldn't you broadcast some kind of recall signal?
entries.source: Couldn't you broadcast some kind of recall signal?
entries.translation: 你們不能廣播某種召回訊號 嗎？

entries.label: NOT_THIS_MODEL
entries.body:
No, not catalog item 2418
(Remote Self-Replicating Robot Explorer Probe).
The model with the recall transmitter was catalog item 2419
and the Melnorme said it was out of stock.
entries.source:
No, not catalog item 2418
(Remote Self-Replicating Robot Explorer Probe).
The model with the recall transmitter was catalog item 2419
and the Melnorme said it was out of stock.
entries.translation:
不能，第 2418 號目錄商品沒有
（遠程自我複製機器探索探 測器）。
附召回發射器的型號是第 2419 號目錄商品
但梅爾諾姆說缺貨。

entries.label: mega_self_destruct
entries.body: I don't suppose you have some kind of Mega-Self-Destruct Code, or something?
entries.source: I don't suppose you have some kind of Mega-Self-Destruct Code, or something?
entries.translation: 我猜你們沒有什麼超級自毀 代碼之類的東西吧？

entries.label: WHY_YES_THERE_IS
entries.body:
WHY YES, THERE IS!
You're a genius, Traveller! Why didn't we remember that!?
Oh... there's a problem though! How are we going to transmit the code?
Well, while we ponder that problem, at least we can give you the code sequence.
That way, if you run into a probe, you can destroy it without getting shot at.

entries.translation:
當然有！
旅行者，你是天才！ 我們怎麼會忘記！？
喔……但有個問題！ 該怎樣傳送代碼？
嗯，在思考這個問題時， 至少可以先把代碼序列交給 你。
這樣遇到探測器時， 不用挨打也能摧毀它。
